network_note: Hashes are near-workspaces sandbox hashes. They cannot be looked up on a public explorer. A testnet re-run is planned (scripts/attack-gallery.sh --network testnet, not implemented).

not_done.what: Solana devnet mintTo on the genesis mint
not_done.why: Needs a Solana devnet program; the gallery is NEAR sandbox only.
Offline verify.sh tamper is a separate deliverable (scripts/verify.sh --tamper-all), not a contract attack.

not_done.what: call a method that changes the stream or payout recipient after open
not_done.why: No such method exists in core or market: the recipient is fixed at create_trial / pool open. A04 and M02 attack the only reachable paths and assert the recipient is unchanged.
Core has no platform-withdraw method (launch fee goes to a fixed treasury via permissionless pay_launch_fee). The market has withdraw_platform and M04 attacks it.
Core has no AMM. Sandwich and min_out are market attacks (M06).

not_done.what: F0 genesis (MPC child key) attacks and Solana-side checks
not_done.why: sign_genesis (Task 4.6) is not built; NEAR cannot see Solana, so confirm_genesis is a signed claim audited by verify.sh (detected, not prevented). The gallery attacks only the contract-side state machine, leaves and plan.

not_done.what: launcher against the real token factory (token.primitives.testnet)
not_done.why: The sandbox factory is a mock that creates nothing. The real factory runs only on testnet: see evidence/instant-testnet (factory behaviour, registration with 0.00125 NEAR, failed-creation refund).

not_done.what: freeze auto-expiry and the 7-day cap timelock by waiting
not_done.why: Both are 7 real days even on the demo profile (only the launcher's day unit is 10 s). A sandbox wait would need about 2 million blocks. I36 and I38 assert the bound with the pure kruxa_logic functions and the queued effective_at instead.
Not in market 1.1.0 (cut first in CO-7); nothing to attack.
